messages:
Priya Kapoor: Heads up — customer C-472 reporting intermittent 429s across /v1/generate and /v1/chat since ~02:10 UTC. Multiple users hit quotas even though usage looks low on their side. Anyone oncall?
Marco Chen: On it. Can you paste tenant id + a failing request id? Also which region?
Priya Kapoor: tenant=c-472, sample req id=req_0a9f4b, region=us-west-2. Example curl they ran:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-***' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-small","input":"hello"}'
```
Luca Romano: digging into limiter logs for c-472. Seeing refill scheduler next_run set way out in future: "next_refill=1719800000 (in 6 days)". Also log line: `refill_interval=60000s` which looks wrong.
Nadia Patel: That 60000 came from the config overlay we rolled yesterday (was trying to switch to ms). I think the parser expects seconds but someone put ms.
Sam Ortega: Ah right — the config change from yesterday renamed REFILL_INTERVAL_MS -> REFILL_INTERVAL and we forgot to divide by 1000 in the loader. So 60_000ms became 60000s.
Marco Chen: Can we hotfix the loader or change the runtime config? What's fastest to restore customers?
Luca Romano: Fastest is to patch the k8s env for the limiter to set REFILL_INTERVAL=60 (seconds) for the affected namespaces and restart pods. Hotfixing code will take longer because deploy cadence.
Priya Kapoor: Support: can we pre-authorize a temporary quota bump while infra fixes it? I'll update ticket. @support-bot please add note.
support-bot: Noted. Ticket C-472 updated: temporary quota increase pending. Customer notified with ETA ~15m.
Marco Chen: Rolling the fix now:
```
kubectl -n infra set env deployment/limiter REFILL_INTERVAL=60
kubectl rollout restart deployment/limiter -n infra
```
deploy-bot: rollout started for deployment/limiter (infra) — 3/3 updated replicas, 0->1 ready.
Luca Romano: I'm seeing success: refill events resumed for tenant c-472, 429 rate dropped to baseline. Logs show `refill_interval=60s` and token counts rebounded.
Priya Kapoor: Nice. Customer confirmed API is back for them. Thanks team. :tada:
Sam Ortega: Follow-ups I propose: add validation in config loader to reject intervals >3600s or values that look like ms (e.g., >10000), add unit suffix support (s/ms), and add an alert if any tenant's next_refill > 24h.
Nadia Patel: Agreed. I'll open a PR for the loader validation + unit tests. Also adding an integration test that loads the overlay and verifies parsed values.
Marco Chen: I'll create an ops runbook for this class of issue and add a Grafana alert rule for refill_interval anomalies.
Priya Kapoor: Support action items: send a short postmortem blurb to the customer and offer a 10% credit for the outage window. I'll draft.
Luca Romano: Quick note — please add a k8s manifest diff check in the deploy pipeline to prevent accidentally dropping ms->s conversions.
Sam Ortega: +1. Also we should add a lint step for config overlays.
Priya Kapoor: Thanks all. Closing the immediate thread. We'll track follow-ups in the PM and the postmortem ticket. :thumbsup:
